in_sanskrit.name: द्रुव
in_sanskrit.meaning: दिक् पर दिशाओं से दिक् दिखता हुआ, समीकरण का सामग्री, अविरल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is visible from all directions, the collection of points, the immovable

in_hindi.name: द्रुव
in_hindi.meaning: दिक् पर दिशाओं से दिक् दिखता हुआ, समीकरण का सामग्री, अविरल
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is visible from all directions, the collection of points, the immovable

in_tamil.name: திருவ
in_tamil.meaning: உட்படியல், உடல் அல்லது உடவுக்கள் அல்லது உடல் அல்லது உடன் அல்லது உடன்மை
in_tamil.long_meaning: That which is manifest or present, the substance or material, the body or the essential self

in_telugu.name: ద్రువ
in_telugu.meaning: దిక్ పర్యేశోఽభూష్ఠః, దిక్ పరే దీశోయిన, సమీకరేశ్వరః, అవిర్జీవ
in_telugu.long_meaning: He who is present or exists in all directions, the one who is self-manifested, the embodiment of sameness, the immovable

in_marathi.name: Druv
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ray of Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Druv हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Druv is derived from the Sanskrit word 'druva' which means a ray or a beam of sun. It symbolizes strength, virtue, determination, and steadfastness. Druv is a name that signifies the power of the sun and the strength it brings.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Druv একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Druv is derived from the Sanskrit word 'druva' which means a ray or a beam of sun. It symbolizes strength, virtue, determination, and steadfastness. Druv is a name that signifies the power of the sun and the strength it brings.
